targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: [2026-08-11 governance, V3-EXQ-919, confirmed]: the redesigned, unconditional whole-episode measurement (no screen, no tiering, n=40 pre-registered seeds, A-A control bit-identical) that 867b's own autopsy called for is now complete and decisive. All readiness preconditions green; harm-aware selection engages robustly (150+ fires per ON-arm cell, every seed). C1_TASK_OUTCOME_IMPROVES_UNCONDITIONAL FAILS (mean delta -0.00373, rel. improvement -3.1%, wrong-direction relative to the criterion); C2 (mechanistic PE corroboration) also fails to corroborate (-0.0000422), and engagement anti-correlates weakly with outcome (Spearman rho -0.286). This is the first structurally decisive negative result in the 844/867/867a/867b/919 lineage -- not a repeat of a prior measurement-instrument defect (re-derive brake: 0 prior substrate_ceiling hits; granularity-debt check: 919's failure signature differs structurally from 844's partial-corroborated negative). The built magnitude-only harm-bias/categorical-override substrate (Form B two-stage design) is a reasonable but partial translation of its own grounding lit-pull (targeted_review_threat_modulated_defensive_path_selection), which explicitly flagged escapability and threat-predictability as additional biologically-supported co-determinants deferred at build time. Route: /implement-substrate (amend SD-hazard-aware-policy-decomposition) to add one or both deferred input channels before re-testing this claim; do not re-queue the magnitude-only design under a new letter.

learning_extracted: The first structurally decisive test in a 5-generation lineage (844/867/867a/867b/919) is a clean negative for magnitude-only harm-aware selection
The built substrate is a partial, not full, translation of its own grounding literature review -- escapability and threat-predictability were explicitly deferred, not omitted through oversight
Engagement anti-correlating (not merely failing to correlate) with outcome is a real, if modest, signal worth carrying forward rather than treating as pure null
